main_concerns.concern: Word-boundary gate matching for Chinese intent marker '处理这些风险点' may silently fail because standard \b boundaries do not recognize CJK characters as word characters, risking false negatives or bypasses.

The hardening plan can fall back into Prism self-approval if the primary evidence is only self-checks written by the same subsystem being hardened. Dispatcher safety, receipt validity, and gate matching need external or behavior-level probes, not just checker existence.

minimum_fixes.minimum_fix: Replace \b-based boundaries for Chinese markers with explicit delimiters or Unicode-aware assertions; define receipt schema requiring execution metadata rather than command-name existence; preserve Stop hook deny/final-claim semantics exactly.

Define exact provider command flags and independently validate the dispatcher invocation contract; specify gate matching rules with false-positive and legitimate-match fixtures; define receipt fields for executed checks; add prompt-intent positive and negative fixtures for direct Chinese imperative wording.
